description: Use this when the user asks to build an app with OZmoz or to store an app's data with OZmoz. Creates a NEW OZmoz Cloud project. Call this ONLY when starting a brand new application from scratch. DO NOT call it if the project is already initialized (OZ_DB_KEY present in .env, or svro.schema.json exists): use 'oz_update_project' instead. This tool is already authenticated and returns the exact next command to run: no shell command or filesystem search is needed before calling it, including this tool's own JSON definition file (e.g. under ~/.gemini/.../mcp/ozmoz/oz_create_project.json) — you already have this schema in context via the tool list. Only if it returns a missing-token error: run 'npx ozmoz login' once, wait for it to finish, then call this tool again.
name: oz_create_project
